text:
Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Braid Throw Pillow - 12 x 24 Inch, Red / White / Black
Colors: Multi
This multicolor modern throw pillow evokes the notion of fire with its faded red, white, and black pattern. Plaited ropes of all three colors adorn the edges in a textured double-stripe. Wool/cotton Imported 12"L x 24"W With the zipper placed on the back, this pillow showcases a handwoven, hand-stitched braid for added texture. 1 throw pillow Spot clean with a damp cloth, and then allow to air dry. Rather than pulling at any loose threads, please use scissors to trim them.
